effect.name: ds/shadow/2xs
effect.description: shadow-2xs. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-2xs), 0px 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.16). Barest lift — hairline-level separation for tightly packed UI.

effect.name: ds/shadow/xs
effect.description: shadow-xs. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-xs), 0px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.16). One step above 2xs; still reads as flat at a glance.

effect.name: ds/shadow/small
effect.description: shadow-sm. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-small). Building block of material-small; a light single-layer shadow for slightly raised elements.

effect.name: ds/shadow/medium
effect.description: shadow-md. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-medium), two-layer (0px 2px 2px + 0px 8px 8px -8px). Building block of material-medium.

effect.name: ds/shadow/large
effect.description: shadow-lg. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-large), two-layer (0px 2px 2px + 0px 8px 16px -4px). Building block of material-large.

effect.name: ds/shadow/xl
effect.description: box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-xl), three-layer (0px 1px 1px + 0px 4px 8px -4px + 0px 16px 24px -8px). Heavier than Large; used for standalone elevated surfaces above the Material scale.

effect.name: ds/shadow/2xl
effect.description: box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-2xl), three-layer (0px 1px 1px + 0px 8px 16px -4px + 0px 24px 32px -8px). Heaviest plain shadow, one step below Modal-elevated.

effect.name: ds/shadow/border-base
effect.description: shadow-border. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-border-base) → 0 0 0 1px. The 1px hairline outline shared by every Material — composes into border/border-small/medium/large/tooltip/menu/modal/fullscreen.

effect.name: ds/shadow/border-inset
effect.description: box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-border-inset) → inset 0 0 0 1px. Inset variant of border-base, drawn inside the edge instead of outside — used where an outer ring would clip against a parent.

effect.name: ds/shadow/background-border
effect.description: box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-background-border) → 0 0 0 1px var(--ds-background-200). Pairs with border-base in every Material shadow stack so the edge stays legible against Background 1 and Background 2 alike.

effect.name: ds/shadow/border
effect.description: material-base. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-border); border-radius: 6px. Everyday use — the default resting surface for cards and panels.

effect.name: ds/shadow/border-small
effect.description: material-small. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-border-small); border-radius: 6px. Slightly raised above the page.

effect.name: ds/shadow/border-medium
effect.description: material-medium. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-border-medium); border-radius: 12px. Further raised than Small.

effect.name: ds/shadow/border-large
effect.description: material-large. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-border-large); border-radius: 12px. Further raised than Medium — same radius, deeper shadow.

effect.name: ds/shadow/tooltip
effect.description: material-tooltip. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-tooltip); border-radius: 6px. Lightest floating shadow. Tooltips are the only floating element with a triangular stem.

effect.name: ds/shadow/menu
effect.description: material-menu. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-menu); border-radius: 12px. Lift from the page — dropdowns, popovers, context menus.

effect.name: ds/shadow/modal
effect.description: material-modal. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-modal); border-radius: 12px. Further lift than Menu — dialogs and modals.

effect.name: ds/shadow/fullscreen
effect.description: material-fullscreen. box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-fullscreen); border-radius: 16px. Biggest lift — fullscreen takeovers.

effect.name: ds/shadow/modal-elevated
effect.description: box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-modal-elevated) → 0 0 0 1px var(--ds-gray-alpha-400) + three-layer shadow (32px/8px/8px blur). Used for a modal stacked above another modal, or any surface that must read above material-modal.

effect.name: ds/focus/ring
effect.description: focus-visible ring. box-shadow: var(--ds-focus-ring) → 0 0 0 2px var(--ds-background-100), 0 0 0 4px var(--ds-focus-color). Two-layer keyboard-focus ring: an inner gap in the surface color so the outer ring never touches the element it outlines.

effect.name: ds/focus/border
effect.description:
Single-layer focus outline: 0 0 0 var(--ds-focus-color) with no background gap.
Used where the two-layer --ds-focus-ring would overflow a clipped parent.

grid.name: Layout/Page 1200
grid.description:
Standard page shell.
--geist-page-width: 1200px → max-width
--geist-page-margin: 24px → padding-inline (resolves to --geist-space-gap)
--geist-page-width-with-margin: 1248px

Two layers: the centred 1200px band is the content cap; the 24px bands at each edge are the page gutter. Below 1248px the cap stops applying and only the gutter remains — the same behaviour as in the browser.
Apply to a frame 1248px or wider to see both layers.

grid.name: Layout/Page 1400
grid.description:
Wide page shell, for the broadest application layouts.
--ds-page-width: 1400px → max-width
--geist-page-margin: 24px → padding-inline
--ds-page-width-with-margin: 1448px

Two layers: the centred 1400px band is the content cap; the 24px edge bands are the page gutter.
Apply to a frame 1448px or wider to see both layers.

grid.name: Layout/Page 1200 12 Columns
grid.description:
12 columns inside the 1200px content box, 24px gutter.
Column 78px = (1200 − 11 × 24) ÷ 12. Span 12 × 78 + 11 × 24 = 1200px.
Apply to a frame 1200px wide.

Not a Geist token. The production bundle ships four column utilities — grid-cols-1, -2, -4, -12 — and defines no container, column or gutter variable. Gutter 24px = gap-6 = --geist-space-gap.
Figma: under Center alignment the Width field holds one column, not the container.

grid.name: Layout/Page 1400 12 Columns
grid.description:
12 columns inside the 1400px content box, 24px gutter.
Column 94px: exact division gives 94.67, rounded down to keep whole pixels. Span 12 × 94 + 11 × 24 = 1392px, leaving 8px slack.
Apply to a frame 1400px wide.

Not a Geist token. The production bundle ships four column utilities — grid-cols-1, -2, -4, -12 — and defines no container, column or gutter variable. Gutter 24px = gap-6 = --geist-space-gap.
Figma: under Center alignment the Width field holds one column, not the container.

grid.name: Layout/App Shell 1220
grid.description:
Application shell: fixed sidebar + fluid content.
max-w-[1220px] → max-width on <header> and <main>
xl:grid-cols-[260px_1fr] → sidebar 260px, content takes the rest

Two layers: the 260px band at the left is the navigation column; the stretched band is the content column. The shell itself is capped at 1220px and centred (md:mx-auto).
Source: the Geist docs shell in production — <main class="max-w-[1220px] xl:grid xl:grid-cols-[260px_1fr]">. The sidebar collapses below the xl breakpoint; at narrower widths the two columns stack.

Not a Geist token. 1220 and 260 are literals in the app markup, not CSS variables — unlike Layout/Page 1200, which maps to --geist-page-width.
Apply to a frame 1220px wide.
